Job Summary: The Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) provides operations support services and business solutions to the community of 10,000 House Members, Officers and staff.

The CAO organization comprises more than 800 technical and administrative staff working in a variety of areas, including information technology, finance, budget management, human resources, payroll, child care, food and vending, procurement, logistics and administrative counsel.

This position is located in the Enterprise Applications (EA) Directorate, House Information Resources (HIR), Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), U.S. House of Representatives (House).

The EA Directorate provides a variety of software system platforms that support financial and human resource functions, as well as the automation of service requests for the CAO and House Community. This position serves as the HRIS Applications System Analyst.

The HRIS Applications System Analyst supports the daily system operations, maintenance, implementations, enhancements, and upgrades of the US House’s current ERP Infor/Lawson application and supporting HRIS applications.

The incumbent will act as a systems administrator and developer for Infor/Lawson version10.0.11., subsequent software release versions, as well as migration to other HRIS applications at the House.

These skills shall be used to support configuring the application and maintaining the servers and databases to provide the best Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) solutions for CAO customers and customer support units. The incumbent will work with other team members who help support the Human Resource Application Systems.

Please note, this is a system administrator role, not a developer role. Responsibilities include application development and system administration for Infor/Lawson and related HRIS applications.

The position requires daily interaction with other House teams (e.g., Enterprise Operations, Security, Infrastructure, and Network Operations) as well as the HRIS business team members. This position does not have supervisory/managerial responsibilities. This position has access to Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

Primary Duties/Responsibilities: Application server administration, HRIS product installation and upgrade, monitoring and HRIS performance Perform tuning activities to improve application and database performance.

Provide troubleshooting for isolating technical problems in the Infor/Lawson Application Architecture including Window Servers, SQL databases, .Net, and IIS Assist HRIS team members to analyze issues with customizations and interfaces, using Lawson 4GL, PowerShell, Perl scripting, UNIX/LINUX scripting and other programs Assist in planning tasks required to identify, install and test patches and maintenance releases for HRIS applications.

Install and test HRIS patches, bundles, and service packs, and migration of custom codes/programs. Provide knowledge transfer and internal training to HRIS team members. Work with HIR business units (Network, Windows, and Security Administrators) to build and deliver services in a stable and secure multi-instance hosting environment.

Assist with capacity planning, disaster recovery and load balancing activities in the hosting environment. Support production environments and events (outages and deploys) during regular working hours and specified off hours and create backups and refreshes of the instances. Performs other official duties and special projects assigned.
Qualifications: Minimum: 1-5 years of relevant professional experience required. Bachelor’s degree in a discipline related to the position or an equivalent level of work experience is required.

Demonstrated experience with Infor/Lawson S3 version10.0.11, LSF Security, Landmark 11.x, Informa Software (Image Quest), BSI, MHC Document Express, IIS, MS SQL, and Windows Server, or comparable experience. Experience administering a high-availability, multi-server ERP environment in a production support capacity.

Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology is strongly preferred. Experience with HTML, JavaScript, PowerShell, UNIX/LINUX scripting, Perl scripting, SQL queries, HR Talent and Landmark IPA technology and Security is strongly preferred. Experience with AI preferred.

Security Requirement: This position requires that the applicant obtain and maintain an applicable U.S. Government security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.

We will not submit your application for a clearance unless you are a U.S. citizen. **Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactorily completing a criminal history records check (or other applicable security clearance) and a pre-employment drug-test (pre-identified position only).

Our remote-first culture is built on trust, collaboration, continuous learning, and autonomy. We're passionate about technology, but even more about people.

If you're looking to join a team where your experience matters and your impact is visible, welcome to Darwoft . About the Role We're looking for a Senior SAP SD Functional Analyst with strong expertise in SAP Vehicle Management System (VMS) and hands-on experience with the VELO transaction .

This role is focused on supporting and optimizing end-to-end vehicle lifecycle processes within an automotive or heavy machinery environment. You'll work across sales, logistics, procurement, finance, and external integrations to ensure SAP VMS processes operate efficiently and align with business needs.

The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of SAP SD, vehicle allocation and sales processes, variant configuration, VMS action matrices, and cross-module integration with SAP MM and FI/CO. What You'll Be Doing Configure, support, and optimize SAP SD and SAP VMS business processes.

Manage the complete vehicle lifecycle within SAP VMS, from production or procurement through inventory, customer allocation, sales, delivery, billing, and after-sales processes. Configure and operate the SAP VELO transaction , including vehicle search, overview, detailed VIN information, and process actions.

Define and maintain the VMS Action Matrix , including primary and secondary actions that control vehicle status transitions. Configure vehicle master data, chassis or VIN information, vehicle statuses, and configuration matrices. Support end-to-end vehicle sales processes, including quotations, sales orders, outbound deliveries, and billing.

Configure vehicle allocation rules for assigning vehicles in stock or production to dealer and customer sales orders. Integrate SAP VMS with SAP SD pricing and Variant Configuration processes. Configure pricing conditions based on vehicle characteristics such as model, engine, color, equipment, and optional features.

Collaborate with SAP MM teams on procurement processes, purchase orders, goods receipts, supplier invoicing, and vehicle stock movements. Support subcontracting and vehicle modification processes involving external suppliers and accessory installation.

Ensure acquisition, logistics, and modification costs are correctly allocated and tracked at VIN level. Coordinate SAP VMS integration with SAP FI/CO for financial postings, cost control, and vehicle profitability. Analyze incidents and business requirements, identify root causes, and propose functional solutions.

Perform basic debugging and collaborate with ABAP developers on technical investigations. Work with SAP VMS BAdIs and enhancement points to implement customized business logic. Support IDoc-based integrations and interfaces with automotive manufacturers, OEM systems, dealer platforms, and third-party applications.

Produce functional specifications, process documentation, test scenarios, and user guides. Participate in functional testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, deployments, and post-production support. Work directly with business stakeholders, dealers, importers, logistics teams, and technical teams.

What You Bring 5+ years of experience as an SAP SD Functional Consultant or Functional Analyst. Strong hands-on experience with SAP Vehicle Management System — VMS . Advanced knowledge of the VELO transaction and its main operational components. Proven experience configuring and managing the VMS Action Matrix.

Strong understanding of vehicle lifecycle processes, vehicle statuses, VIN management, and vehicle allocation. Solid experience with SAP SD sales processes, including sales orders, deliveries, billing, pricing, and customer management. Experience with SAP Variant Configuration and characteristic-based vehicle pricing.

Strong understanding of integration between SAP VMS, SD, MM, and FI/CO. Experience with automotive procurement, vehicle inventory, goods movements, and supplier invoicing. Knowledge of VIN-level acquisition, modification, and logistics cost management. Experience with IDocs, interfaces, and integrations with external systems.

Ability to perform basic SAP debugging and collaborate effectively with ABAP teams. Familiarity with SAP VMS BAdIs, user exits, and enhancement frameworks. Experience preparing functional specifications and coordinating technical developments. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills.

Advanced understanding of automotive or heavy machinery business processes. Knowledge of importer, dealer, fleet, OEM, and dealership operational models. Good communication skills and the ability to translate business requirements into SAP solutions. Nice to Have Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations or migrations.

Participation in full-cycle SAP implementation projects. Experience integrating SAP with OEM manufacturing systems or dealer management platforms. Knowledge of SAP Warranty, Customer Service, or after-sales processes. Experience with interfaces using APIs, middleware, SAP CPI, or PI/PO. SAP SD or SAP Automotive certifications.

Experience working with distributed international teams. The primary purpose of this position is to serve as a management analyst to support the full range of the VA MMS portfolio of responsibilities.

The incumbent assists managers by providing objective information to make administrative and programmatic decisions to improve effectiveness, resource efficiency and resource savings for all components of the VA. The incumbent regularly monitors data and processes to ensure compliance with VA policy and guidance.

The incumbent participates in development of manpower staffing requirements determination models, studies or standards. The incumbent routinely works to process and coordinate actions for organizational or position change requests.

Responsible for conducting analysis and using authoritative data sources to develop and publish manning documents/business intelligence dashboards develop new staffing requirement standards or models; conduct studies; review and recommend decisions on organizational or position change requests.

The MMS functions are critical to the VA's resource allocation process and evidence-based decision-making processes. Supports all VA Central Office (VACO) Staff Offices and the Administrations by providing objective and independent analysis of the efficiency of organizational structure and position management.

Conducts independent analysis regarding manpower requirements needed to support success with the organizations' mission, function, and tasks. The incumbent supports the analysis required to maintain statistically sound standards and tools to be used across the VA to develop and implement staffing models or studies.

Conducts research, defines problem areas and causes, develops solutions, recommends solutions to an organization's leadership or designee and assists an organization's leadership or designee in implementing the recommendations.

Conducts research and analysis that are complicated by the need to consider and evaluate the impact of changes in regulatory and legislative requirements, long-range program goals, and relationships between officials and offices throughout the VA. Develops innovative solutions to identified process and work limitations.

Develops statistical and narrative data to support changes and recommendations. Provides managers with methods and tools to quantify organizational outcomes, mission capability, process capability, and resource utilization effectiveness. Prepares and presents briefings to managers on study findings and recommendations.

Provides technical leadership, advice, and assistance on highly complex, controversial, or precedent setting matters; and creative and imaginative solutions to challenging problems including high visibility programs, unusual urgent matters, or critical issues which require application of the full range of advanced scientific and experimental techniques.

Develops directives, procedures, and instructions for current and long-range manpower staffing requirements to meet the stated mission, functions, and tasks of the program under review.

Participates in validation of staffing models, standards, and studies resulting in authoritative manpower staffing requirements to be used in the develop of budget submissions and resource allocation decisions. Participate in system testing, validation efforts, and issue resolution activities.
Ensure requirements and solutions align with VA policies, operational needs, and federal compliance standards.

Amazon.com’s Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic e-commerce marketplaces in the world, with nearly 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in ten countries.

BRP safeguards every financial transaction across all Amazon sites. As such, BRP designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimize risk and maximize trust in Amazon.com. BRP organization is looking for a Business Analyst for its Operations Analytics team.

The team is being grown to provide insights about its BRP operations and provide analytical solutions to help drive operational efficiencies, uncover the hidden risks and trends, reduce investigation errors and bad debt, improve customer experience and predict & recommend the optimizations for future state of BRP operations.
As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying opportunities through the use of business intelligence, data mining and visualization techniques.

You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards.

The candidate should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and present the insights in concise and effective manner.

Additionally, the candidate should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impacts the bottom line of the business.

· Use analytics and data mining techniques to solve complex problems and drive business decisions.
· Employ the appropriate tools, methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse and help reduce bad debt
· Design experiments, test hypotheses, and build actionable models to optimize BRP operations
· Solve analytical problems, and effectively communicate methodologies and results
· Build analyses for product launches and operations and help predict workflow and capacity requirements for BRP operations
· Draw inferences and conclusions, and create dashboards and visualizations of processed data, identify trends, anomalies
· Work closely with internal stakeholders such as business teams, engineering teams, and partner teams and align them with respect to your focus area
A day in the life
Pipeline Operations — Monitor and triage Datanet ETL jobs; resolve dependency timeouts, upstream delays, and schema drift; coordinate with data providers on blocked feeds; backfill data when logic changes.
Ad-Hoc Investigations — Query fraud/abuse signal tables for point-in-time analysis; investigate multi-account abuse patterns (linked accounts, ATO, concession leakage); decrypt/trace customer IDs across evaluation systems.
Dashboard & Reporting — Build/maintain QuickSight dashboards on Redshift aggregates for MAA metrics; add dimensions as needs evolve; validate metric definitions against production logic.
Business Reporting — Prepare WBR/QBR inputs (abuse BPS, goal tracking, forecasts); support goal-setting with prior-year reconciliation; generate ad-hoc regional/program splits.

## About Our Client ##
Notre client est une institution académique de référence basée dans le canton de Vaud, évoluant dans un environnement international et technologique.
Son organisation IT accompagne la transformation numérique et l'évolution des processus métiers au service de ses différentes communautés.
## Job Description ##
* Analyser les besoins métiers et les traduire en exigences fonctionnelles et applicatives.
* Concevoir et rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles générales et détaillées.
* Challenger les besoins métiers et proposer des solutions adaptées aux standards des produits.
* Paramétrer et adapter des solutions applicatives selon les besoins identifiés.
* Réaliser des analyses détaillées et des prototypes afin de valider les solutions envisagées.
* Construire et maintenir une roadmap centrée sur les résultats et les priorités métiers.
* Préparer les estimations, planifications et différents livrables projets.
* Organiser et accompagner les phases de recette et les tests d'acceptation utilisateurs (UAT).
* Coordonner les parties prenantes internes : utilisateurs métiers, équipes IT, architectes et responsables applicatifs.
* Piloter les interactions avec les prestataires et partenaires externes en Suisse et à l'international.
* Identifier les risques et dépendances et communiquer régulièrement sur l'avancement des projets.
* Accompagner l'intégration de solutions du marché dans le système d'information existant.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Formation supérieure en informatique ou parcours professionnel jugé équivalent.
* Minimum 7 à 8 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de Business Analyst ou Functional Analyst.
* Expérience concrète et indispensable dans le paramétrage de solutions applicatives.
* Expérience dans l'intégration de progiciels, solutions SaaS ou applications du marché.
* Solide maîtrise de l'analyse des besoins et de la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles.
* Expérience des processus de recette, tests fonctionnels et UAT.
* Bonne expérience en gestion de projets IT, suivi de roadmap, risques et planning.
* Capacité à challenger les besoins et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques.
* Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse, de communication et de vulgarisation.
* Autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément.
* Une certification Agile, gestion de projet ou HERMES constitue un avantage.
* Français et anglais courants, niveau C1 ou équivalent.
## What's on Offer ##
* Un **CDD de 12 mois renouvelable à 100 %**, au sein d'un environnement professionnel international et stimulant.
* Une mission à fort impact, au cœur de projets de transformation et d'évolution du système d'information.
* Un environnement favorisant la collaboration, le développement professionnel et la formation continue.
